title: The Red Door Opened to 1994 | ECHO//100 Episode 5
description: Kavi confronts the manifestation of the Red Door, only to face a memory-wiping intervention from Mira. Episode 5 of ECHO//100: ARC. This is an AI-assisted original fiction work.

scenes.text: The Red Door vibrates, turning solid concrete into swirling liquid beneath Kavi’s trembling sneakers.
scenes.caption: Concrete melting away
scenes.image_prompt: A vertical shot of a mysterious glowing red door standing in a suburban backyard; the concrete ground around it is turning into viscous liquid, Kavi in red hoodie standing nearby.

scenes.text: Kavi reaches for the handle, but a high-pitched hum shatters the silence, freezing movement.
scenes.caption: The humming threshold
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi reaches toward the metallic red door, his hands shaking; Byte floats beside him, his cyan face glowing intensely in the dark backyard.

scenes.text: Suddenly, Mira appears as a flickering hologram, her teal coat shimmering with aggressive static.
scenes.caption: Mira’s sudden arrival
scenes.image_prompt: Mira’s holographic form manifests near the door, wearing a sharp teal coat, her face stern and projected in blue light.

scenes.text: Mira forces a hard reset on the phone, purging the last hour of fragile memories.
scenes.caption: Memory wipe initiated
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi looks down at his phone screen, which emits a blinding white light, wiping his recent history; his expression is dazed.

scenes.text: The door pulses, displaying a date from 1994, revealing a machine for time travel.
scenes.caption: A temporal gateway
scenes.image_prompt: The surface of the red door displays glowing digital numbers reading 1994; the air around it warps with temporal distortion.

scenes.text: Byte secretly encrypts a hidden file, shielding full knowledge of these endless, repeating loops.
scenes.caption: Byte’s hidden secret
scenes.image_prompt: Byte hides a glowing orange data packet behind his back; his cyan face shows a complex, knowing expression while Mira looks away.

scenes.text: Mira vanishes, leaving Kavi alone with the door as it begins to creak open.
scenes.caption: The door opens
scenes.image_prompt: The red door slowly swings inward, revealing a blinding, impossible light spilling out into the dark backyard.

scenes.text: A voice drifts from the void, identical to Kavi’s, begging for salvation from within.
scenes.caption: My own voice
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi stands frozen in front of the open door; his reflection in the doorway seems to look back at him with terror.
